newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Pacific Internet extends Net service.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Pacific Internet extends Net service.

text.p: Singapore's Internet service provider (ISP) Pacific Internet said on Thursday it had increased its global roaming access services to 142 countries, covering more than 500 cities.
Pacific Internet customers can have local call access to the Internet from every major city instead of having to pay for long-distance calls to connect in Singapore, it said in a statement.
Pacific Internet is a consortium comprising Sembawang Media, which is part of Sembawang Corp and Singapore International Media.

The expanded service is in partnership with Asia Internet Holdings, the international consortium operating a high-speed Internet network linking major cities in Asia, and with i-Pass Alliance, which provides a global network for worldwide Internet roaming.
Pacific Internet also announced a fast-access service for corporate subscribers which included a fax service -- where susbcribers can receive faxes via electronic mail.
